title: bromus arvensis f. violaceus
intro: Bromus arvensis f. violaceus, commonly known as purple brome, is a subspecies of the Bromus arvensis plant, which is a type of grass that grows in various parts of the world. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus arvensis f. violaceus include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve spasms, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effects.
